page.notes: Running head and page number read from the top corners. The catchword "per" and signature "Q 2" are at the foot; the signature is partly obscured. The title is set in a mix of italic and small capitals; the Latin text is transcribed as printed (long s written as s, u/v and i/j normalised). Hyphenated line-end words in the title are kept with their printed hyphens. No marginal notes are visible. Some letters in the title and first lines are slightly blurred ("Iohannem", "Pirckheymer") and may be doubtful, but are read as printed.
